verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a drag-and-drop visual editor plus a code editor, Design Studio for drafting emails, AI-generated global styles for on-brand design, a reusable Assets library, and inbox previews for checking how emails render across clients. Personalization is supported by injecting API data into messages. A community user independently found building, editing and previewing emails straightforward and intuitive. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reusable email templates/snippets, documented personalization token syntax (e.g. Liquid) and how tokens render, and independent corroboration of cross-client rendering fidelity.
